en: A black and white vintage postcard showing a cobblestone public square surrounded by historic multi-story buildings with shuttered windows and awnings. The square features a small fountain with a statue in the left foreground. Several signs are visible on the ground-floor shops. A couple of people are seen walking, and there is an old-fashioned cart in the center of the square. The postcard has a white border and a caption at the bottom.
